title: First photo of Earth from space
body:
A captured German V-2 launched from White Sands, New Mexico, carried a 35mm movie camera about 65 miles up.

It took the first photographs of Earth from space. The rocket crashed in the desert, but the film, sealed in a steel case, survived.
photoNote: The actual frame from the V-2 camera. U.S. Army, White Sands, public domain. Grainy by nature, which suits the card.
